title: chenopodium ambrosioides proles suffruticosum
intro: Chenopodium ambrosioides proles suffruticosum, commonly known as Mexican tea or Epazote, is a perennial herb native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce nausea, and act as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its carminative properties, which help to relieve flatulence and bloating, as well as its emmenagogue properties, which stimulate menstrual flow and alleviate menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Chenopodium ambrosioides proles suffruticosum include alkaloids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
